display_name.zh: 多 Agent 协作调度器

description.zh: 面向分析、开发、审查、测试和后台跟踪的多 Agent 协作调度器。提供父子任务委托、消息传递、等待、续作、中断、原生控制台，以及生命周期诊断和提示词阶段工具过滤。优先使用 SQLite Event Store；不可用时回退内存并在响应中标明。工具网关只过滤 Agent 的可见工具，不是操作系统权限沙箱，也不拦截已发出的调用。
description.en: Multi-agent collaboration orchestrator for analysis, development, review, testing, and background tracking. It provides parent-child delegation, messaging, waiting, follow-up runs, interruption, a native dashboard, lifecycle diagnostics, and prompt-time tool filtering. It prefers SQLite Event Store and reports an in-memory fallback when SQLite is unavailable. The gateway filters tools visible to Agents; it is not an OS permission sandbox and does not intercept already-issued calls.

description.zh: 提供十三个协作与控制工具，用于创建与跟踪 Agent、投递消息、续接终态 Run、等待、中断、详情与任务树查询、事件监听、设置和历史管理。Agent、Run、消息、检查点、树上下文和 Agent 游标优先持久化到 SQLite Event Store schema v4，SQLite 不可用时响应会标明内存回退。spawn、send、followup 和 interrupt 支持 request_id 幂等；执行 epoch 隔离恢复与迟到结果。全局活动 Run 可配置为 1–16 或 0（不限），单根任务树活动槽可配置为 1–8 或 0（不限）；两者有限时单根上限不高于全局上限。宿主 AI 瞬时故障自动重试 0–12 次，默认 5 次，-1 表示不限；余额、认证、参数和策略错误不重试。写路径和只读标记仅用于调度检查及提示约束，不构成操作系统权限隔离。
description.en: Provides thirteen collaboration and control tools for creating and tracking agents, messaging, continuing terminal Runs, waiting, interruption, detail and task-tree queries, event watching, settings, and history management. Agents, Runs, messages, checkpoints, tree context, and Agent cursors prefer SQLite Event Store schema v4, with responses reporting an in-memory fallback when SQLite is unavailable. Spawn, send, follow-up, and interrupt support request_id idempotency; execution epochs isolate recovery and late results. Global active Runs are configurable from 1 to 16 or 0 for unlimited, and per-root active slots from 1 to 8 or 0 for unlimited; when both are finite, the per-root limit cannot exceed the global limit. Transient host AI failures are retried 0-12 times, default 5, with -1 meaning unlimited; balance, authentication, parameter, and policy errors are not retried. Write paths and read-only flags are scheduling and prompt constraints, not OS permission isolation.

display_name.zh: 工具生命周期探针与 Agent 工具网关
display_name.en: Tool Lifecycle Probe & Agent Tool Gateway

description.zh: 提供七个诊断与 Agent 工具网关工具。生命周期探针记录宿主 hook 字段和协作运行时明确绑定的 Agent 工具调用；诊断缓冲仅存内存，重启丢失。网关在 prompt compose 阶段过滤可见工具，并在公开插件工具的 IPC 执行入口校验调用上下文，阻止 Agent、summary 和 finalization 通过动态包激活调用固定隐藏工具。非空白名单优先，宿主缺少工具列表时关闭式返回空列表。
description.en: Provides seven diagnostic and Agent tool-gateway tools. The lifecycle probe records host-hook fields and Agent tool invocations explicitly attributed by the collaboration runtime; diagnostic buffers are in memory and lost on restart. The gateway filters visible tools at prompt-compose time and validates caller context at public plugin-tool IPC entry points, preventing Agent, summary, and finalization contexts from invoking fixed-hidden tools through dynamic package activation. A non-empty allow list takes precedence and fails closed when the host omits the tool list.
